_comment: Copy to state/factory.local.json (never committed) and put your own values in. .claude/scripts/lib/factory_local.py merges it over state/factory.json. mold_sources: where `mold.py fetch <mold_id>` clones each mold from. live_projects: an existing live deployment the factory must only read (optional). legacy_names: {current: old} spellings of state keys older applications still carry (optional).
